items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And I was with Tommy Dorsey’s band when Frank was a boy singer for about two years. And I loved Frank.

ctx.x: You made a statement I think about Art Tatum, that he was a surgeon, what he did?

Yeah. I guess so, yeah. I was in a different racket. I was a lawyer and he was a surgeon. I couldn’t — whereas Johnny Smith played with us a few weeks at a time, he’s on one of the CD’s that you have here on “The Road to Oslo” with Bing Crosby, the Alliance Jazz, and Johnny Smith, Jake Hanna and Milt Hinton and myself, we were with Bing on tour. I loved being with him. We were never presented more beautifully and he just was a jazz aficionado. And I’ve done a couple of things for the Sinatra, at Hofstra…
That’s right. The musician’s union wouldn’t allow any recording.
